members.algorithm: Use a best-fit style priority that ranks bins by smallest residual capacity after placement, so the fullest feasible bin is chosen first to minimize fragmentation and bins used.
members.code:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return one priority for each feasible bin.

    ``bins`` contains remaining capacities after filtering bins that cannot
    hold ``item``.  The evaluator selects the first maximum priority and
    opens a new bin when the array is empty.
    """
    return -(bins - item)

members.algorithm: Use a worst-fit style priority by ranking residual capacity after placement from largest to smallest, so the emptiest feasible bin is preferred to leave room for future items.
members.code:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Return one priority for each feasible bin.

    ``bins`` contains remaining capacities after filtering bins that cannot
    hold ``item``.  The evaluator selects the first maximum priority and
    opens a new bin when the array is empty.
    """
    return bins - item
